sections.title: Introduction
sections.content:
# Welcome to Our Company!

We're excited to have you on board. This handbook covers essential policies and procedures.

## Company Values
- **Innovation**: We embrace creativity and new ideas
- **Integrity**: We act with honesty and transparency
- **Collaboration**: We work together across teams

Please review this carefully and reach out to HR with any questions.

sections.title: Key Policies
sections.content:
## Work Hours & Flexibility

Our standard office hours are 9 AM to 5 PM. We offer flexible arrangements:

- **Remote Work**: Approved on Tuesdays–Thursdays
- **Core Hours**: 10 AM–3 PM (all team members present)
- **Flexible Start/End**: Within 8 AM–6 PM window

### Time Off

| Type | Annual Allowance |
|------|------------------|
| PTO | 20 days |
| Sick Leave | 10 days |
| Holidays | 10 days |

> **Note**: Policies are subject to local labor laws and company discretion.

sections.title: Benefits & Support
sections.content:
## Health & Wellness

We provide comprehensive health coverage:

1. **Medical Insurance**: HMO and PPO options
2. **Dental & Vision**: Preventive care covered
3. **Mental Health**: Free counseling and wellness programs
4. **Fitness**: Company gym membership subsidy

### Professional Development

Invest in your growth with:
- Annual training budget ($2,000)
- Conference attendance support
- Internal mentorship program
- Tuition reimbursement (conditional)

**Contact HR for details and enrollment.**
